queries.result: Search found Delta State's official property-registration and land-based administration page, which links the Ministry of Lands and Surveys procedure, C-of-O statistics, and Area Planning Offices. No official Asaba parcel viewer or public parcel API was identified.

registryBasis: Delta State's official land-administration procedure identifies the Ministry of Lands and Surveys and gives an Asaba address for the Fasttrack Desk, while the official Area Planning Offices document lists an Area Planning Office, Asaba. This evidences a local/state registry custodian and procedure, not an open parcel data service.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Delta State Government, Ministry of Lands and Surveys
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official procedure says land registration is handled through the Ministry of Lands and Surveys and gives the Fasttrack Desk address at Professor Chike Edozien Secretariat, Asaba. It refers to survey plans and survey-lodgment certificates, but publishes no parcel layer or map API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Delta State Government, Ministry of Urban Renewal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official PDF lists an Area Planning Office, Asaba, at No. 5 Oney Ofuokwu Street, behind Presidential Lodge, off DLA Road. It is a custodian/procedure lead, not machine-readable parcel geometry.
Official DLI page labels the property-registration and land-based administration process and links the Ministry of Lands and Surveys materials.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Delta State page inspected; links to land-registration procedure, C-of-O statistics, and Area Planning Offices. No map/API endpoint advertised.

geometryDecision: No GeoJSON retained. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available from an official Asaba service, and the exact WUP point was not used to infer absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identity if publicly exposed
remainingUncertainty: The official local/state custodian and registration procedure are evidenced, but public map/API availability, parcel-layer schema, CRS, exact-point inclusion, and citywide coverage remain unverified.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently check whether the Delta State Ministry of Lands and Surveys or Surveyor-General exposes a current anonymous map/service endpoint, then qualify a small geometry-only sample before any adapter consideration.
